item.description: 📆 Top News Today ❗️ The President of Russia, in his capacity as the Supreme Commander-in-Chief, ordered Russian forces to cease attacks on Kiev for three days starting at midnight today, due to the talks — and preparations thereof — with American negotiators to be held in Kiev. 🚩 Exploiting success: the Yuzhnaya Group's units liberated the settlement of Kurtovka of the Donetsk People's Republic. 💥 Thwarting the enemy's plans: the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike using high‑precision ground‑based weapons and long‑range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against metallurgical plants that supply military defence enterprises, as well as logistics centres and power substations. 🎮 Gerans' inspection : hit an enemy drone production plant , a logistics centre , radar stations , and vessels , used in the interests of the AFU. 🔥 Aviation says 'hello' : thee Russian Aerospace Forces crews hit UAV command posts of the AFU. 🤝 Your courage will live for ages : Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin presented awards to participants of the special military operation undergoing treatment and rehabilitation, as well as medical personnel of the military hospital in Volgograd. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to carry out strikes against logistics centers, defence industry enterprises, port infrastructure facilities in Ukraine, and v
item.description: ❗ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to carry out strikes against logistics centers, defence industry enterprises, port infrastructure facilities in Ukraine, and vessels used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 📍 During the day, long‑range attack unmanned aerial vehicles struck the industrial enterprise LLC Black Ammo in the settlement of Borispol of Kiev region. The enterprise specialises in the production, purchase, and supply of ammunition and explosives to Ukraine’s law enforcement and security agencies. 📍 In addition, a dry cargo ship carrying military‑technical equipment supplied by Western countries to the Armed Forces of Ukraine was damaged in the Chernomorsk port in Odessa region. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 Your courage will live for ages Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of
item.description: Your courage will live for ages 🤝 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin presented awards to participants of the special military operation undergoing treatment and rehabilitation, as well as medical personnel of the military hospital in Volgograd. 💬 On behalf of Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin conveyed words of gratitude to the servicemen. 'Congratulations on the deserved combat awards, I thank you for your loyalty to the military duty, the oath and Russia,' said the Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation. ▫️ For personal achievements in the recovery and rehabilitation of participants of the special military operation, doctors and medical staff of the hospital received medals 'For Help and Mercy'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29231

Your courage will live for ages
🤝
Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin
presented awards to participants of the special military operation undergoing treatment and rehabilitation, as well as medical personnel of the military hospital
in Volgograd.
💬
On behalf of Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin
conveyed words of gratitude to the servicemen.
'Congratulations on the deserved combat awards, I thank you for your loyalty to the military duty, the oath and Russia,' said the Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation.
▫️
For personal achievements in the recovery and rehabilitation of participants of the special military operation, doctors and medical staff of the hospital received medals 'For Help and Mercy'.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
